note: v15 cleaned: only wired T1 params, docs, albedo /255 fix, cell feather fixes tile cut, lean reusable FBM

noise.note: procedural hash in shader, not sampler

puddle.albedo: 0-255 RGB base puddle color. Dark (10,40,80) for water. Mixed with darkBase. Now auto /255.
puddle.colorStrength: 0-1 how much floor albedo replaced by puddle tint. 0.55 subtle, 0.92 full.
puddle.tintMix: 0-1 mix darkBase vs pure albedo. 0=only darkened floor, 1=pure albedo.
puddle.darkBaseFactor: 0-1 darkening of floor before tint. 0.65 darker base less saturated.
puddle.noiseScaleLarge: World scale of large blobs. Smaller= larger pools. Tweak live.
puddle.threshold: 0-1 noise cutoff where cloud becomes puddle. Lower=more coverage.
puddle.feather: 0-0.2 softness of threshold edge. Higher=softer cloud edge.
puddle.cellFeatherLow: Tile border feather low (0). Tweak to remove straight cut.
puddle.cellFeatherHigh: Tile border feather high (0.28). Higher=more bleed across tiles, fixes your screenshot cut.
puddle.heightGroutLow: Height tex threshold: below this = definitely grout/low
puddle.heightGroutHigh: Height tex threshold: above this = not grout
puddle.grooveMin: Min puddle strength in non-grout when heightInfluence=1. Lower= only grout gets puddles.
puddle.heightInfluence: 0=ignore height/AO (puddles everywhere), 1=strongly prefer low/grout. If flat floor, lower heightGroutHigh to see effect.
puddle.worldLowHigh: World Z high: above this less puddle
puddle.worldLowLow: World Z low: below this more puddle (floor depressions)
puddle.maskBoost: Overall opacity boost after grout/world bias. 1.2 subtle, 1.4 strong.
puddle.edgeLow: Edge mask low for foam rim
puddle.edgeHigh: Edge mask high for foam rim
puddle.edgeFoam: 0-0.5 bright foam rim strength. Low=0.08 subtle.
puddle.flatStrength: 0-1 how much normal becomes flat up (0,0,1) as water surface.
puddle.metalMix: 0-1 how much metal removed in puddle (water non-metal).
puddle.rippleScale: UV scale for ripple normal. 0=off, 3=visible ripples.
puddle.aoMix: 0-1 how much AO darkening removed under water.
puddle.floorDepress: -0.5..0.5 height depression where puddle (negative lowers floor). Now wired live, was dead before.

docs.system: All are T1 live-edit via UBO ModifiersBlock (binding=1). No regen. heightAdd/aoWeight/noiseScale/normalStrength/roughAdd were dead legacy and removed.
